records.name: Nebinger PTA
records.summary: Parents, teachers and neighbors who support George W. Nebinger School. They plan school events, fundraisers and volunteer days, and anyone can come to the general meetings.
records.what_you_do: Come to a general meeting, sign up for a volunteer shift on the school's volunteer calendar, or help plan events. Members also help with teacher appreciation, fundraising and the school Book Fair.

schedule.text: General membership meetings, open to everyone. Dates are listed on the group's Google calendar.

cost.text: Meetings are free. Membership is paid each year through the PTA's online shop, and the price is not shown on the site.

first_step.how: Come to a general membership meeting, which needs no membership. To join, use the PTA's online membership shop, then sign up for a volunteer shift.
first_step.basis: All are welcome at general meetings with no membership needed, and the site gives a clear way to join.

records.notes: IRS legal name is PTA Pennsylvania Congress (EIN 832888238); the batch aka is Nebinger PTA, and the everyday name is used here. The site is the school PTA's own page. Status rests on posted meeting minutes dated September 24, 2026. Membership price is not on the site; the join page sends people to the online shop. Contact page is https://www.nebingerpta.org/contact (no email or phone shown). Social icons on the site link to placeholder pages, so none recorded. The site has a volunteer clearance resources page, so check what clearances volunteers need before the volunteer line goes live. Meeting dates are on a Google calendar link that was not read.

notes: Batch file holds 15 groups, not 14 as the file name suggests; all 15 are handled. Verdicts: publish 11 (only Nebinger PTA is a full record with a summary, status active; the other 10 are held back as status unknown with no summary), not_a_group 1, hide 3 (Raleigh Area Alumnae Association as private, Reclaim Philadelphia as partisan, Reconstruction Inc as defunct; the last two are judgment calls flagged in their notes). Searches: 2 of 2 used, both on Philasoup Inc and Richard Chappelle Recovery Center; neither gave usable evidence. Fetches: about 28 of 60. Blank pages on two tries: philasoup.org and readysetlive.org. Domains that do not resolve (www and bare tried): phillyyogafactory.com, rshphilly.org, rwaphilly.org (batch WWW.RWAPHILLY.ORG), rsaphilly.com, richardchappellerecovery.com. Security flag: outandbackpartyrun.org now serves a gambling page; treat as hijacked and do not link it. The Polish Heritage Society site in the batch is the national ACPC site; the Philadelphia group appears only as an ACPC affiliate. No rate limiting seen on the fetch tool. Search budget ran out before the 10 unknown groups could be checked, so a second pass with search budget would help most for Philasoup, Racquets Serving Hope, Ready Set Live, Ready Willing and Able, Philly Yoga Factory, Resident Spouse Association and Richard Chappelle Recovery Center.
